MODIFIED: LOGISTIC(mean,scale[,seed]) is a random draw from a logistic distribution; rewritten by inverse CDF mean+scale*LN(u/(1-u)) with u=RANDOM_UNIFORM(0,1[,seed]) via two added auxes (u_seeded, u_unseeded). Same distribution, NOT the same random stream as the original tool. Upstream MIT license unchanged.

MODIFIED: ROOTN(x,n) rewritten as IF_THEN_ELSE(x<0, -((-x)^(1/n)), x^(1/n)) (PySD lacks ROOTN; odd-root behavior for negative x assumed [unverified]). Verified: rootn(-27,3)=-3, rootn(144,2)=12. Upstream MIT license unchanged.

MODIFIED: SINWAVE(a,p) -> a*SIN(2*pi*TIME/p) and COSWAVE(a,p) -> a*COS(2*pi*TIME/p) (COSWAVE also unsupported). Definition assumed [unverified]; values at t=0: wave=0, wavecos=10. Upstream MIT license unchanged.
